name: Jason Waterman (silhouette only, NOT A LIKENESS)
depiction: Jason Waterman, from Watford, Hertfordshire, who ran from Border Force officers at Bagby airfield, North Yorkshire, in October 2015, leaving a suitcase holding about 7 kg of cocaine in a hedgerow; on the run in Spain for almost two years; swam to Gibraltar and handed himself in in June 2017; pleaded guilty at Bradford Crown Court in December 2017 and was jailed for seven years and two months. Named because he pleaded guilty and is widely named (NCA, Yorkshire Post, IBTimes UK). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette in a plain dark jacket: no face, no features. NOT A LIKENESS.
